_comment: Analysis parameters, fixed at the protocol freeze. Decisions: see protocol/protocol.md section 12.
_h3_note: Max |mean member AUROC difference| between strength-matched pairs (proposal: 0.01).
_budget_note: Decided 2026-11-09: K = ceil(b x primary predicted negatives); b = 0.10 confirmatory, 0.05/0.20 secondary. H2 compares at identical total flagged workload (label-free top-M).
_equivalence_note: Decided 2026-11-09: no equivalence (TOST) test. Report paired estimates, 95% CIs and superiority tests; non-significance is not interpreted as equivalence.
_transfer_note: Decided: absolute gap in predicted-negative share, pooled per (partition, seed, primary) over outer folds and inner models.
